meta.title: Rundinova Studio — Your professional image, your orders on WhatsApp
meta.description: Rundinova Studio builds an immersive online storefront for small businesses in Burundi. Your customers discover your products and order directly on WhatsApp.

hero.kicker: Image studio for Burundi's small businesses
hero.title: Your professional image,
hero.lead: Shoes, clothes, food… We create a unique online storefront for your business, in 3D and in motion. Customers discover it on their phone and message you directly on WhatsApp.

how.title: Three steps, and your business looks the part

steps.title: We get to know you on WhatsApp
steps.text: Tell us about your business, your products and your prices. Send us your photos, we take care of the rest.

steps.title: We build your storefront
steps.text: A unique storefront in your name, animated and in 3D, at your own address: your-shop.rundinova.com.

steps.title: Customers order on WhatsApp
steps.text: They browse your products and message you in one tap. The QR code printed on your shirt leads straight to your storefront.

shops.title: Storefronts that make people want to buy
shops.lead: Each storefront is tailor-made for its business. Here are the first ones.

yours.title: Your shop here
yours.text: Your name, your products, your own .rundinova.com address.

why.statement: Customers buy with their eyes first. A beautiful image builds trust before the very first message.

points.title: One address to share
points.text: A simple link for your statuses and groups, instead of dozens of photos that get lost.

points.title: Your products, always on show
points.text: Your products, prices and contacts stay in one place, day and night.

points.title: Ordering made easy
points.text: One button, and your customer messages you directly on WhatsApp.

points.title: You sell the way you always do
points.text: No complicated website to manage: sales carry on over WhatsApp, between you and your customers.

offer.title: Simple and transparent
offer.lead: One pack to get started, then a single all-inclusive subscription. No commitment.

pack.label: Launch pack
includes: Your shirt with your shop's QR code

monthly.label: Subscription
includes: Your storefront online, at your .rundinova.com address
Updates to your products and prices

pause.title: What if a month isn't paid?
pause.text: No worries. Your storefront simply goes on pause and shows your customers an elegant page. As soon as the subscription is paid, it's back online.
pause.previewText: The shop will be back very soon.

items.q: Do I need a computer or technical skills?
items.a: No. Everything happens on WhatsApp: you send us your details and photos, we build the storefront.
On your storefront, they tap the WhatsApp button and a chat with you opens. You handle the sale as usual.

items.q: Is it an online shop with card payment?
items.a: No. It's a storefront: it presents your business and products. Orders and payment are settled between you and your customers, on WhatsApp.

items.q: What does the launch pack include?
items.a: A shirt with your shop's QR code, your storefront and the first month of subscription. After that, it's {monthly} FBu per month, all inclusive.

items.q: Can I stop whenever I want?
items.a: Yes. The subscription has no commitment: you can stop at any time.

items.q: What happens if I miss a month?
items.a: Your storefront goes on pause with an elegant page for your customers. As soon as you pay, it's back online.
By mobile money. We give you all the details on WhatsApp.

items.q: Can my business have a storefront?
items.a: Shoes, clothes, food, beauty, crafts… If you sell products, let's talk.
